name: dome_vessel
description: Hollow BRCK/TTAN containment shell over a CNCT (non-conductive) floor cap.
why: Build-lessons 'a conductive floor or plane shorts the whole build': the verified non-conductive structural materials are BRCK, CNCT and GLAS (NOT TTAN, METL, BMTL); this shell uses BRCK+TTAN for the dome body (radiation/heat resistance) but caps the floor in CNCT so a stray BTRY never shorts the vessel. blueprint_lint flagged the TTAN band as a conductive_floor_span (90% of the build's width); fixed by splitting it into two TTAN halves with a 2px INSL gap at the midpoint -- the rule's own suggested fix -- which breaks the continuous conductive run without changing the band's visual/radiation-shielding role.
source: save2, BRCK+TTAN dome x222-300 y211-345 (BRCK 1389, TTAN 1074, CNCT floor y340-345)
